from functools import lru_cache

def max_coins(nums):
    n = len(nums)

    @lru_cache(maxsize=None)
    def best(mask):                    # mask: balloons still standing
        if mask == 0:
            return 0
        alive = [i for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1]
        result = 0
        for k, i in enumerate(alive):  # burst balloon i next
            left = nums[alive[k - 1]] if k > 0 else 1
            right = nums[alive[k + 1]] if k + 1 < len(alive) else 1
            result = max(result, left * nums[i] * right + best(mask & ~(1 << i)))
        return result

    return best((1 << n) - 1)
